_about: RATIFIED Company Standard LIAB-EXCLUSIONS-MSA-001 — extracted verbatim from the LeapSwitch
document cited below, under the manager's standing rule that whatever is
stated in our approved legal documents is the final position (recorded
2026-08-19). Ratified 2026-08-20 under the owner's coverage-gap tasking
It is CONFIGURATION: no all_lock.md entry, no locked decision amended.
PRESENCE Requirement: it verifies the provision EXISTS. The clause's CONTENT goes to Legal with the evidence — categorical value comparison is a V2 evaluator (CLAUSE_CATALOGUE.md).

Distinct from LIABILITY-MSA-001, which reads the CAP VALUE at 17.2. This standard reads whether the indirect/consequential-damages EXCLUSION exists at all. The audit of 2026-08-20 found that a counterparty cap matching six months with no exclusion registered a clean MATCH while being a materially worse deal; the two Requirements together close that.

_terminology: Mapping terminology, ratified with the standard on 2026-08-20. Every term is
drawn from the cited source clause's own wording or names the clause type
generically; no term encodes a legal position (rules 7/21 - the position lives
in `configuration.expected_presence`, sourced above). confirm_threshold 5 is
STRUCTURAL and matches the 21 standards ratified 2026-08-19: one exact phrase
confirms. Locked 35.9 fixes no threshold and 35.10 requires calibration
against a representative counterparty set before the value is trusted;
recalibration is a new mapping rule version (data), never a code change.
Verified against the real source document by tools/verify_terminology.py.
COUNTERPARTY CALIBRATION, 2026-08-21 (locked 35.10 direction; owner
tasking to calibrate against public sources until real counterparty
contracts arrive). The terminology below gained generic DRAFTING VARIANTS
observed in public specimens — public web terms and public SEC EDGAR
filings, test specimens only under the owner authorization of 2026-08-18.
Every added term is a synonym for how the clause type is worded, or the
clause type's generic name. NO added term states a legal position, and no
position, threshold or tolerance was touched by this pass (rules 7/21).
Safety: an alias or keyword group scores 3 against confirm_threshold 5, so
no single generic term can confirm a mapping on its own - two independent
signals are always required. Recalibration remains a data change.
_legal_rule_note: APPROVED ZERO-TOLERANCE LEGAL RULE (manager ruling 2026-08-19; owner
approval to wire, 2026-08-20). MATCH -> ACCEPTABLE (no decision needed);
ANY deviation -- an absent provision included -> UNACCEPTABLE -> Legal
Decision required; nothing that differs is ever auto-approved. There are
deliberately NO thresholds and NO tolerance bands: do not add
acceptable_max or approval_required_above, and do not ask for them --
the policy is that none exists. Wired as deviation_outcome +
unlimited_outcome, both read by the evaluators; an unrecognised value
fails closed to NOT_APPLICABLE and a human (ENG-09, Step 20 r4).
